week.name: Wednesday
week.short: Slight Chance Light Rain then Partly Sunny
week.detailed: A slight chance of rain between 8am and 11am. Partly sunny. High near 52, with temperatures falling to around 49 in the afternoon. East wind around 2 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.

week.name: Thursday
week.short: Patchy Fog then Slight Chance Light Rain
week.detailed: Patchy fog before 9am, then a slight chance of rain. Mostly sunny, with a high near 51. West southwest wind around 2 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%.
week.night_short: Slight Chance Light Rain then Areas Of Fog

week.name: Friday
week.short: Areas Of Fog then Mostly Sunny
week.detailed: Areas of fog before 9am. Mostly sunny, with a high near 52.

week.name: Monday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 61.
